drafts.title: Reply Rate
drafts.pitch: Same idea; Cursor celebrates a perfect reply rate, then reads the thread and finds the replies are Null's own.
drafts.reason: Cursor's "A perfect reply rate!" is a good eager misread, but "Wait. These are yours." explains the joke and leaves Tilde's line redundant.

drafts.title: Good Number
drafts.pitch: Same idea; Null defends the matching counts before setting the phone down.
drafts.reason: Null's "It's a good number" is a funny denial, but it talks over the silent phone-down and steps on Tilde's punchline.
